title: Tool Proficiency
contents: text | At Level 3, you gain proficiency with Alchemist’s Supplies. If you’re already proficient, choose another set of Artisan’s Tools.
text | Brewing a potion now takes ½ the usual time (DMG crafting rules).

title: Alchemist Spells
contents: text | When you become an Alchemist by getting the Alchemist class feature at Level 3, you get these spells prepared for you at the Artificer levels shown:

title: Alchemical Savant
contents: text | When casting a spell using your <Alchemist's Supplies as your Spellcasting Focus, you may add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to one of the healing or damage spell's rolls:
bullet | Healing roll — when restoring Hit Points.
bullet | Damage roll — if the spell deals Acid, Fire, Necrotic, or Poison damage.
bullet | This bonus applies once per spell.
bullet | Your DM may allow alternative tools as your focus, for thematic purposes.

title: Restorative Reagents (Alchemist)
contents: text | Your reagents offer powerful restorative effects.
text | When a creature drinks one of your elixirs, it also gains temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier + Artificer level.
text | You can cast <Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot or preparing the spell.
text | This requires using your <Alchemist's Supplies as your focus.

title: Chemical Mastery (Alchemist)
contents: text | Once on each of your turns, when you cast a spell that deals Acid, Fire, Necrotic, or Poison damage, you can also deal 2d8 Force damage to one of the targets hit.
text | You gain Resistance to both Acid and Poison damage.
text | You can cast <Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron without expending a spell slot, without preparing it, and without material components. Usable once per Long Rest.

title: Experimental Elixir
contents: text | After each <Long Rest, create 2 random elixirs using your <Alchemist's Supplies.
text | Anyone can use a Bonus Action to drink or administer one to a creature within <5ft.
text | As a Magic Action, expend a <spell slot to brew an elixir of your choice.
text | See the <Experimental Elixir table for details.
text | You can craft the following number of random elixirs <after each Long Rest.
text | You may still brew more manually using spell slots.

title: Experimental Elixir Table
contents: text | You may create elixirs using the table below, as per the Experimental Elixir feature.
